title: B2B Services Domain
description: Project, subscription, and hybrid B2B services with financial, customer, contract, labor, acceptance, and billing data.

forbidden_interpretations: Treating revenue timing mismatch as an accounting conclusion
Attributing margin movement to a driver when bridge residual fails
safe_stop_rules: Use generic Boundary when the business model is outside B2B services
Return Not Assessable when required customer, contract, delivery, or timing roles are absent

terminology.acceptance: customer confirmation that contracted work was accepted
terminology.custom_contract: a contract with scope or delivery terms materially tailored to one customer

expected_relationships.description: A shift toward lower-margin services may reduce enterprise gross margin.
Unpriced delivery hours may reduce contract margin.

mechanism_catalog.explanation: Low-margin contract mix may explain aggregate margin decline.
expected_support_patterns: mix share rises while segment margin gap persists
expected_counter_patterns: mix is stable or high-margin share rises
mechanism_catalog.prohibited_conclusion: Do not claim causality when the bridge residual fails.

mechanism_catalog.explanation: Delivery effort above plan may erode project margin.
expected_support_patterns: hours exceed plan and contract margin declines
expected_counter_patterns: overrun is billed or accepted as a change order
mechanism_catalog.prohibited_conclusion: Do not label all additional effort as waste.

expert_triggers.review_question_template: Does the identified recognition-versus-acceptance timing require an accounting treatment review?

safe_stop_rules: No cause conclusion without required roles
No response when blocking counter evidence is unresolved
